headline: Redwood Research reports deployment-grounded simulated control evaluations on LinuxArena
summary: Redwood Research introduces simulated control evaluations (SCEs), using a language model grounded in honest tool-use trajectories and a code snapshot to simulate attack-policy tool responses without executing attack actions in the deployment environment. On LinuxArena, the authors report that SCEs predicted safety across five monitors with a 3.6 percentage-point RMSE at a 5% audit budget, compared with 10.1 points for attacks executed in the separate BashArena control setting. These are author-reported results from one executable benchmark. Appendix E adds preliminary evidence that simulated benign behavior resembles redacted internal Redwood research/engineering sessions, but those sessions contain no attack attempts; control-metric transfer beyond LinuxArena, simulator trust and independent reproduction remain open.
